MONGODB FOR STARTUPS

# MongoDB for Startups Partner Community

MongoDB for Startups helps innovators scale from ideation to IPO. Provide your portfolio companies with free Atlas credits, expert support, and self-serve technical enablement on MongoDB.

Partner With Us

## Why Partner with Us

Empower your portfolio companies with powerful developer tools and services, critical technical consultations, and a robust ecosystem of solutions to accelerate growth and success.

![general_content_expertise](https://webimages.mongodb.com/_com_assets/icons/general_content_expertise.svg)

### About MongoDB

MongoDB supports startups with quick iteration, scalability, and flexibility. MongoDB Atlas makes scaling effortless, while multi-cloud support speeds up building modern apps, enabling rapid growth.

![general_features_automation](https://webimages.mongodb.com/_com_assets/icons/general_features_automation.svg)

### Program Perks

MongoDB for Startups offers your portfolio free Atlas credits and Voyage AI tokens, 1:1 expert support, go-to-market opportunities, and self-serve technical enablement.

![industry_finance](https://webimages.mongodb.com/_com_assets/icons/industry_finance.svg)

### Voyage AI Is Now Included in MongoDB for Startups

Empower your portfolio with advanced embedding and reranker models for high-performance retrieval. Help founders gain efficiency, leverage domain-specific models, and access state-of-the-art AI that outperforms other leading solutions.
